people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
translations.bsb: The hail fell and the lightning continued flashing through it. The hail was so severe that nothing like it had ever been seen in all the land of Egypt from the time it became a nation.
translations.kjv: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
translations.asv: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
